entries.title: Friend suggestions
entries.description: You can find people you may know in the friends panel and your requests, based on mutual friends, shared communities, and titles you both follow. New suggestions appear over time, and you can dismiss any you’re not interested in for a month.

entries.title: Pin posts to the top
entries.description: You can pin up to three posts on your profile, and community managers can pin one post at the top of their community.

entries.title: Search and sort profile libraries
entries.description: You can search someone’s library, filter it by type, sort by last update, title, or release year, and show only the titles you both have.

entries.title: Easier inviting
entries.description: You can switch between inviting friends and sharing invite links using separate tabs in the invite window.

entries.title: Protection from bots on sign-up and log-in
entries.description: You may see a quick automatic check when you sign up or log in, which helps keep spam accounts out of Orbis.

entries.title: Steam no longer reports old games as newly played
entries.description: Only games you’ve actually started playing recently show up as first plays, instead of games you played long ago.

entries.title: Your picture on posts shared to Discord
entries.description: If you don’t have a profile picture, posts shared to a community’s Discord now show your initial instead of the community’s icon.
